title: Finding a Unity Deeper Than Race, Color, or Creed | SRF/YSS President Brother Chidananda

# Finding a Unity Deeper Than Race, Color, or Creed

### Brother Chidananda • Self-Realization Fellowship

Welcome and greetings. In a world often divided by outer differences, Brother Chidananda reminds us of the eternal, underlying unity of all mankind. We are not merely physical bodies or product of custom; we are divine souls born of the same one Father-Mother God.

### The One Light in Many Shells

When we look through the physical senses, we see only duality. But in the deep silence of meditation, the soul perceives the same divine light shining in every heart. This realization is the only permanent solution to the divisions of humanity.

> "Let us look past the superficial differences of race, color, and creed to behold the brilliant spark of the Divine Mother residing in every human temple. In this expanded vision of sympathy, the world becomes our family."

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Cultivate Kindness:** Perform a daily act of kindness without expecting any recognition.
* **Be Gentle:** Cultivate gentle, loving speech with everyone you meet today.
* **Pray for Unity:** Include international peace and brotherhood in your morning and evening meditation prayers.
* **Seek Unity:** Look past outward differences to see the same Divine Light shining in all souls.

May you stay faithfully attuned. Jai Guru!
rawText: We are all divine souls born of the same one Parent. By looking past outer differences in race, color, or creed, we discover the underlying unity of all mankind in God...
